Chapter 212: Chapter 11: The Tremors Of The Chikun Star Domain (Subscribe Please)_2

Chapter 212: Chapter 11: The Tremors of the Chikun Star Domain (Subscribe Please)_2

“Our Peak Master of Canglan Star Domain is actually challenging other Evolvers everywhere?”

“Peak Master Shisan, isn’t it said to be extremely mysterious, having never made a move before?”

“Everyone go, let’s see what the Chikun Star Domain’s Shisan Peak Master is capable of…”

…

Many Evolvers and high-level citizens gathered in the arena area, specifically watching the platform where Lin Yuan usually issued challenges.

“Hello, everyone, I’m your little kitty cat. Today, let’s see, the legendary Chikun Shisan Peak Master…”

...

A cute and personable girl with a pair of cat ears appeared in front of the platform.

She was a popular female broadcaster in the Chikun Star Domain and dozens of nearby Star Domains, often live streaming challenges of some powerful Evolvers.

The Chikun Shisan Peak Master, although not yet Sixth Rank, was highly suitable for live streaming content because of his fame and status.

“Alright, alright.”

“The challenge has started.”

“That one is the Shisan Peak Master. Although I know the appearance has been adjusted, he looks too handsome…”

The girl knew how to engage the live streaming atmosphere well. With just a few words, she immediately lifted the ambiance.

“Our Shisan Peak Master’s opponent is known as ‘Soul Artisan’ Lataza.”

The camera switched.

A gaunt young man in a black robe appeared.

This lean youth was mostly shrouded in a black robe, looking extremely sinister and terrifying.

“Soul Artisan Lataza follows the Soul-type Evolution Path and specializes in eerie soul attacks.”

“The Dao of the soul is extremely dangerous. Lataza once had a record of making a group of Fifth Rank ultimate Evolvers dare not come close. I wonder about Shisan Peak Master…”

The girl thoroughly introduced Soul Artisan Lataza’s past achievements.

“If this were in reality, Lataza would definitely not be a match for Shisan Peak Master, since in reality, Shisan Peak Master would surely have many soul defense weapons.”

“But in the Virtual World, especially in the arena, you can’t bring in any external help, so I think Shisan Peak Master might be in some danger.”

The girl continued her introduction.

A moment later.

The battle between Shisan Peak Master and Lataza began.

Buzz!!

Strange fluctuations started to spread.

The girl was about to introduce the scene on the live stream.

The next moment.

The figure of Soul Artisan Lataza began to collapse.

Starting from his feet, his torso, and both hands, everything began to disintegrate.

“Your soul… is strong…”

In the end, only Lataza’s head remained, and after saying this phrase, his head also began to collapse.

In front of the platform.

The girl blinked her eyes.

Damn.

She had forgotten that Lataza was an Evolver on the Soul-type Evolution Path.

Such Evolvers were known for their swift battles.

“Shisan Peak Master is too strong, able to block Lataza’s soul attacks unscathed. Shisan Peak Master has at least started the soul metamorphosis fusion…”

The girl had explained many high-Rank Evolver battles and had considerable research on the strength of souls.

“It looks like our Shisan Peak Master is about to step into Sixth Rank, and who knows the real identity of Shisan Peak Master…”

The girl finished speaking, her tone betraying a hint of curiosity.

The identity of the Chikun Shisan Peak Master was extremely mysterious, and countless Evolvers wanted to know it.

“Alright.”

“The next challenger for Shisan Peak Master has arrived…”

The girl shifted her attention to the upcoming challenge.

…

“Amazing.”

“The Peak Master is too strong, ordinary Fifth Rank limits are like ants in comparison.”

“Isn’t that supposed to be the case for our Chikun’s Peak Master, being powerful?”

In a private room at the arena, many members of the Red Kun Lineage were gathered here, enjoying the numerous techniques of Shisan Peak Master.

“Is that the Shisan Peak Master?”

Fang Qing was among them, looking at the battle below with some shock.

At this moment, a desolate continent was simulated on the battlefield. But as Shisan Peak Master and his opponent continued to exchange blows,

the continent was torn apart, plates were punctured, and for a time, lava erupted in an apocalyptic sight.

“Too powerful.”

Fang Qing felt a tremor in his heart.

If the battle occurring on the platform had taken place on a Life Planet, that planet would likely have become a Dead Star by now, devoid of any living creatures.

“We Evolvers should be like the Peak Master, possessing the ability to destroy heavens and earth with a mere wave of our hands.”

Not far away, a member of the Tri-Eye Clan sat, clenching his fists tightly.

“Rather than being like some people who are loyal to their friends, wasting time and resources…”

The Tri-Eye Clan man glanced at Fang Qing.

There was a clear implication in his words.

Some time ago, Fang Qing had gathered his friends to help Canglan Star through a crisis, which had made the Tri-Eye Clan man somewhat uncomfortable.

In his view, everything had its own destiny, and forcefully intervening was undoubtedly altering that destiny.

Upon hearing this, Fang Qing dared not speak.

In terms of status, the Tri-Eye Clan man had the red mark in the Seven Star Cave test and had joined the Red Kun Lineage. It was certain that within a century, he would become a core disciple.

Fang Qing could not afford to offend such a figure.

…

Inside another private room.

Twelve figures were leisurely observing.

They were the twelve Peak Masters of the Red Kun Lineage.

With their status, they seldom watched arena matches below the Sixth Rank.

Even arena matches involving Sixth Rank Evolvers were often beneath their interest; among the twelve Peak Masters of the Red Kun Lineage, aside from the initial three beyond the Sixth Rank, the rest were all at the pinnacle of Sixth Rank Peak.

Yet they were naturally willing to come for Lin Yuan’s arena challenges.

“Our little junior brother…”

The second senior brother sighed, taking a careful look, “He must have already begun the soul transformation process, how many years has it been since he reached this level?”

The other senior brothers felt the same.

Not long ago, they joked that within several decades, Lin Yuan had the potential to step into Sixth Rank.

But now? How much time had passed? Lin Yuan had already reached the pinnacle of Fifth Rank and had even begun the soul bonding transformation?

It wasn’t that there were no Evolvers whose soul bonding transformation took hundreds or thousands of years.

But those were Evolvers without any background who had received no guidance from powerful beings before stepping into Fifth Rank, and had chosen an Evolution Path that wasn’t highly compatible with themselves for soul bonding.

For Evolvers from the Red Kun Lineage, before reaching Fifth Rank, their mentors would help them select their Evolution Path.

Such a compatible Evolution Path made the soul bonding transformation naturally swift, completing within just a few years or a decade at most.

In the eyes of the twelve senior brothers, Lin Yuan, being a disciple of the Chikun Star Lord,

was now undergoing a soul bonding transformation and surely had gotten the approval of the Star Lord. He would probably complete the soul transformation within three to four years.

Then he would become a Sixth Rank Evolver.

This was tenfold or even a hundredfold quicker than what they had initially thought when they predicted it would take several decades for Lin Yuan to reach Sixth Rank.

“A Sixth Rank under a hundred years old, is this kind of talent so incredible that one can’t even feel envious?”

The twelfth senior brother sighed.

“Let’s prepare in the next few years, when our junior brother steps into Sixth Rank, he will definitely visit the main star in person, and we should give him a proper welcome.”

One of the senior brothers suggested.

“Of course.”

The twelfth senior brother nodded.

He looked again at the arena below.

“The little guy who was just Fourth Rank has grown to such heights in the blink of an eye?” The twelfth senior brother’s expression turned reflective.

He remembered that during the Seven Star Cave test, he had hesitated whether to take Lin Yuan as a disciple.

…

The red-hued palace.

The Chikun Star Lord and a man in a white robe were playing chess.

“Chikun, you’ve taken a good disciple…” after placing a piece, the man in the white robe remarked thoughtfully.

“Heh heh…”

The Chikun Star Lord just smiled and said no more.

“That new disciple of mine, he was miserably defeated by your good disciple…”

The man in the white robe placed another chess piece.

“Oh?”

The Chikun Star Lord felt a stir of interest.

His vast consciousness immediately began ‘searching’.

Soon enough, he found out about Lin Yuan challenging many Evolvers in the arena area.

“Although my disciple has some talent, to beat your disciple…”

The Chikun Star Lord was puzzled.

He remembered the man in the white robe’s disciple had already been at the pinnacle of Fifth Rank a century ago, and now, he was likely just one step away from Sixth Rank. The soul bonding was probably at ninety percent.

“Still pretending?”

The man in the white robe glanced at the Chikun Star Lord.

“Mmm…”

The Chikun Star Lord kept his expression normal, but inside, he was filled with doubt.

Immediately, he sent a thread of consciousness to carefully observe the scenes of Lin Yuan’s challenges in the arena.

“This…”

The Chikun Star Lord’s face showed a slight change, his expression reflecting surprise.
